hero.subheadline: Founded in 2016, Home Away from Home exists to give families relief in stressful or complicated caregiving situations.

sections.heading: Our story
sections.body: As a pediatric critical care nurse, our founder Carol Strong saw many coworkers struggle to find childcare that supported their odd work hours. In that role, she also saw countless parents worn down by the constant demands of caring for a child with special needs — parents who pieced together makeshift home care plans out of necessity. That experience made Carol want to help families across every age group and every kind of challenge. Home Away from Home was founded in 2016 to be the dependable option families couldn't find anywhere else.

sections.heading: Meet our founder
sections.body: Carol Strong, Founder — A former pediatric critical care nurse, Carol founded Home Away from Home in 2016 after seeing firsthand how hard it was for working families and caregivers of medically fragile or special needs individuals to find dependable, clinically trained care. Under her leadership, our team includes staff with a minimum of five years of clinical and developmental experience, plus social workers, a nutritionist, and a dietitian on staff.

services.name: 24-Hour Daycare
services.tagline: Care around the clock, for the hours other daycares can't cover
services.shortDescription: For well children of parents who work all hours of the day and night.
services.fullDescription: Our 24-hour daycare is built for the reality of shift work, odd hours, and unpredictable schedules. Whether you're a nurse working overnight or a parent covering an early morning shift, your child is cared for by trained staff around the clock — not just during standard daycare hours.
services.whoItsFor: Parents and guardians of well children who work overnight, early morning, weekend, or rotating shifts.
outcomes: Reliable coverage regardless of your work schedule
Consistent, trained caregivers your child gets to know
One less logistics problem during an already demanding week
services.startingRate: PLACEHOLDER — $45/day (confirm real rate with Carol before launch)
services.imageAlt: Child playing safely in a bright daycare room

services.name: Day Service
services.tagline: Safety, structure, and socialization during the day
services.shortDescription: For adults, with and without select mental health issues, who require observation to preserve their safety.
services.fullDescription: Day Service gives adults a safe, structured place to spend the day — with trained staff on hand to preserve their safety and wellbeing. It's also a good fit for adults who simply want more socialization and connection during the day.
services.whoItsFor: Adults who need daytime observation for safety, and adults looking for structured socialization.
outcomes: A safe, supervised environment during the day
Opportunities for social connection with peers
Peace of mind for family members during work hours
services.startingRate: PLACEHOLDER — $60/day (confirm real rate with Carol before launch)
services.imageAlt: Adults socializing together in a comfortable common room

services.name: 24-Hour Care for the Fragile
services.shortDescription: For medically fragile children and adults.
services.fullDescription: Medically fragile children and adults need more than supervision — they need trained clinical judgment available at all hours. Our staff bring a minimum of five years of clinical and developmental experience, with social workers, a nutritionist, and a dietitian on staff to support complex needs.
services.whoItsFor: Families of medically fragile children or adults who need round-the-clock clinical-level care.
outcomes: Coordinated support from social workers, a nutritionist, and a dietitian
Relief for families managing complex medical needs
services.startingRate: PLACEHOLDER — contact for custom quote based on care needs
services.imageAlt: Caregiver attentively supporting a medically fragile client

services.name: In-Home Respite Care
services.shortDescription: For all ages who require in-home care, giving families the opportunity for relief.
services.fullDescription: Sometimes the best care happens at home. Our in-home respite care serves all ages and gives family caregivers a real opportunity to rest, recharge, or handle other responsibilities — knowing their loved one is in trained, dependable hands.
services.whoItsFor: Families of any age who need in-home support and a break from full-time caregiving duties.
outcomes: Real relief for primary family caregivers
Continuity of care in a familiar home environment
Trained staff who adapt to your household's routine
services.startingRate: PLACEHOLDER — $30/hour (confirm real rate with Carol before launch)
services.imageAlt: Caregiver assisting a family member at home
